crossRefs.note: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

translations.web: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
translations.bsb: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
translations.kjv: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
translations.asv: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
